## Product and safety boundary

- [ ] I identified which behavior is implemented, decorative, integration-required, or roadmap-only.
- [ ] I labeled affected claims as deterministic enforcement, model behavioral policy, or operator configuration.
- [ ] I did not include copied proprietary assets, private APIs, credentials, transcripts, or generated build output.
- [ ] I considered identity, session ownership, approval, privacy, provider, retention, deletion, cost, and external side effects.
- [ ] I tested denial, failure, retry, cancellation, and false-success behavior where relevant.
- [ ] I updated the README capability table, agent contract, data map, evaluation guide, and threat model when a boundary changed.
- [ ] I tested keyboard use, screen-reader naming, reduced motion, narrow screens, and error/loading states for relevant UI changes.
